tagline: Every report, traced to its source
brief: A multilingual incident reporting and verification platform for Alappuzha. Residents report floods, waterlogging, blocked canals and waste in Malayalam or English; reports are grouped on a map and conflicting claims stay traceable to their sources.
criteria: Recognisable at 16 px, ties the name to the backwaters, works in one colour and on the app's dark UI.

concepts.name: Canal B
concepts.idea: A bold B split by a canal: the name and the backwaters in one letter.
rationale: The canal cut makes a plain initial ownable and local
Solid, chunky geometry stays legible at 16 px
Teal from the product UI; deep-canal ink for contrast

recommendation: Canal B: ownable, local, and strongest at small sizes.
next_steps: Use the kit files in docs/brand/kit
Run a trademark search before public launch
